figures.caption: Fig 1: Simulation results for the exactly low-rank setting. Each row corresponds to a different choice of (p,m,n). The left and right columns report the prediction errors for U (0) and V (0), respectively, averaged over 100 replications. Error bars denote the standard deviations.

Fig 2: Simulation results for the approximately low-rank setting. Each row corresponds to a different choice of (p,m,n). The left and right columns report the prediction errors for U (0) and V (0), respectively, averaged over 100 replications. Error bars denote the standard deviations.

Fig 3: Out-of-sample canonical correlations across five target cancer cohorts. For each target cohort, the three bars correspond to Trans-sCCA, Pooled-sCCA, and Target-sCCA. The solid and hatched portions represent the first and second canonical correlations (CC1 and CC2), respectively, so that the total height of each bar represents Total CC.
